svg.aria-label: Why does every Fabric workload work on the same copy of the data?
svg.title: Why does every Fabric workload work on the same copy of the data?
svg.text: Why does every Fabric workload work on the same copy of the data?
OneLake sits in the middle; shortcuts and mirroring bring outside data in without pipelines; one capacity pays for all of it

g.title: OneLake
g.text: one logical lake per tenant: every table stored once as Delta Parquet,
read in place by every engine above and below, governed in one catalogue

g.title: Fabric capacity
g.text: one F SKU pool of capacity units that every workload above draws on
smoothing spreads bursts over time; throttling starts when the pool is overdrawn

g.title: legend
g.text: the layer that makes Fabric different
